import re
import sys

assign = re.compile(r"^\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*(\d+)\s*;\s*$")
add = re.compile(
    r"^\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*\(([a-p]|TMP)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\)"
    r"\s*mod\s*100\s*;\s*$"
)

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    if line.lstrip().startswith("//"):
        continue

    match = assign.fullmatch(line.rstrip("\n"))
    if match:
        name, number = match.groups()
        values[name] = int(number)
        continue

    match = add.fullmatch(line.rstrip("\n"))
    if match:
        name, source, number = match.groups()
        values[name] = (values[source] + int(number)) % 100

names = [*map(chr, range(ord("a"), ord("p") + 1)), "TMP"]
print(" ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
